title: Failed Payment with Amount Deducted
eligibilityRule: Bank or gateway captured payment successfully but local order state marked transaction failed; auto-refund eligible within 5 business days.
description: If bank debited funds but order remained in failed state, the captured funds are automatically reconciled and refunded.

title: Refund Pending / Delay Inquest
eligibilityRule: Refund has been initiated in payment gateway and is awaiting banking settlement clearance within standard 7-day turnaround window.
description: Provides verified refund gateway reference and current clearance stage when refund has already been triggered.

title: Return & Exchange Eligibility
eligibilityRule: Products can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused, unaltered, and undamaged.
description: Products can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and undamaged.

title: Return Received Refund Eligibility
eligibilityRule: Returned merchandise has been physically scanned at warehouse; customer is fully eligible for refund release.
description: When an item return is verified as received at the logistics facility, the purchase amount is eligible for automatic refund.

title: Order Cancellation Status & Reason
eligibilityRule: Order cancelled prior to fulfillment; cancellation reason reported strictly if present in backend records.
description: Provides verified cancellation timestamp and recorded cancellation reason from order history.

title: Damaged Product Claim
eligibilityRule: Physical damage claims rely solely on customer claim and require physical proof/photographic verification prior to approval.
description: Physical damage claims must never auto-resolve without objective evidence such as photo proof or return inspection.

title: Duplicate Payment Refund
eligibilityRule: Customers are eligible for a full refund if duplicate successful payments are detected on a single order within 7 days.
description: Customers are eligible for a full refund if a duplicate payment is detected within 7 days of transaction.

title: Wrong Product Received
eligibilityRule: Wrong item shipped requires logistics verification against warehouse outbound barcode scan and reverse pickup.
description: Customer claims different item was received than ordered; requires human logistics review.

title: Account Security Review
eligibilityRule: Any suspected unauthorized account access, login breach, or suspicious device session must be immediately escalated to security ops.
description: Any suspected unauthorized account access must be escalated to the security team for manual review before any account or payment action is taken.

title: Delivered But Not Received (POD Dispute)
eligibilityRule: Carrier marked parcel delivered but customer claims non-receipt; requires courier proof-of-delivery (POD) check with delivery partner.
description: Dispute where tracking shows delivered but customer reports non-receipt requires courier dispatch inquiry.

title: Order In-Transit Status & Delivery Delay
eligibilityRule: Order currently in transit with logistics carrier; provide live carrier tracking status and expected delivery estimate.
description: Provides verified live shipping status and expected delivery timeline for active parcels.
